recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, symmetrical composition featuring a rich, weathered leather background framed by intricate black Victorian-style corner filigree, with elegant gold-toned typography layered over a central decorative divider.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black filigree against a warm, textured background
Luminous gold-gradient text as the primary focal point
Symmetrical framing creating a formal, classical balance
Tactile leather grain providing organic depth to flat graphic elements
coreInvariants: Weathered leather texture with mottled orange and brown tones
Black ornate corner brackets with scrollwork and floral motifs
Central horizontal divider with a stylized heart or flourish

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is centered horizontally and vertically in the upper-middle third; the secondary text sits below the central divider.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, script-style display text in the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright script text, moves down to the central divider, and settles on the secondary serif text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space between the central text block and the ornate corner borders to allow the leather texture to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Burnt orange and terracotta leather tones (Background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale gold to white gradient (Primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with low-value black accents and high-value highlights in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones, black, and metallic gold

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a fluid, slanted formal script with high stroke contrast
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, all-caps transitional serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swash on the initial capital letter
Tapered terminals on the script characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, expressive script with a rigid, spaced-out serif for a classical editorial look.
graphicDevices: Horizontal line divider with central heart-shaped scrollwork

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-contrast calligraphic style of the main text.
Provides the necessary classical serif structure for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of aged, burnt-orange leather with dark vignetting. Add four identical black Victorian filigree corner ornaments and a central horizontal divider with a heart-shaped scroll motif in the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a gold-to-white gradient script font in the upper center. Apply the subtitle in a small, wide-tracked, all-caps gold serif font below the central divider.

verificationChecks: Is the leather texture visible through the negative space?
Are the corner ornaments perfectly symmetrical?
Does the gold gradient on the main text feel luminous?
Is the tracking on the subtitle wide enough to feel airy?

adjustableVariables: Leather color (from deep red to tan)
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting on the leather texture
Ensure the black ornaments are pure black without artifacts
Verify the script text is legible despite the gradient
Confirm the central divider is perfectly aligned with the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Aged leather texture + Victorian corner filigree + Gold script/serif typographic hierarchy = Classical Vintage Cover Aesthetic
